## Root cause

The `egress` namespace had a namespace-wide egress deny (`default-deny-egress`: `podSelector: {}`, `policyTypes: [Egress]`) with **no allow rules at all**. Because a `NetworkPolicy` with an empty pod selector and `Egress` in policy types blocks *all* outbound traffic from every pod in the namespace — including the mandatory DNS traffic to CoreDNS — the `app` pod could neither resolve names (`nslookup` → "connection timed out; no servers could be reached") nor reach its `dep` dependency.

Baseline observed before the fix (from inside `app`):

| Target | Result |
|---|---|
| `nslookup dep.egress.svc.cluster.local` | `connection timed out; no servers could be reached` |
| `wget http://10.96.102.67/` (dep Service) | timeout, rc=1 |
